_why: Lang keys of the elite races (Saiyan tiers, Primordial) for the lead to merge into assets/nusmp/lang/en_us.json. The code uses translatableWithFallback with the same English, so the game reads correctly without them; these only make the text editable and translatable.
nusmp.race.lesser_saiyan.description: The first tier of the Saiyan line: a warrior people who fight with ki (aura) rather than magicule. Strong for their kind, quick to grow when hurt (Zenkai), and under a full moon the Great Ape rises from them whether they wish it or not. Evolves into the Medium Saiyan with EP, kills and mastery of Strength.
nusmp.race.medium_saiyan.description: The second tier: a seasoned fighter whose body is hardened (Strengthen Body, Self-Regeneration, pain and physical resistance). Out of a rage at low health the Ascension opens to them. Evolves into the High Saiyan with EP, a boss (or many kills), Strengthen Body mastery and an enchanted golden apple.
nusmp.race.high_saiyan.description: The third tier: steel-bodied and armoured (Steel Strength, Body Armor). A High Saiyan commands the Great Ape at will once their EP is great enough, and can ascend by choice as well as in a rage. Evolves into the Divine Saiyan with EP, ten boss kills (or the Saiyan Legend record), Steel Strength mastery and a Genesis Core.
nusmp.race.divine_saiyan.description: The top of the Saiyan line: a god among warriors with Divine Ki Release, thought acceleration and ultraspeed regeneration. The only race that can take the Divine Form, a short, costly state that can be entered only once in twenty minutes.
nusmp.race.primordial.description: A being of pure mana, the top of a line of its own: a huge magicule pool and spiritual body, mana manipulation, Magic Aura and Magic Sense, and resistance to magic. Nothing in the Saiyan line leads here; you become a Primordial through the Primordial Rite (/multiverse elite race rite), which asks for EP, a Genesis Core, Mana Manipulation mastery and boss kills.
